brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a site that uses real street/sidewalk data and lets me drop a little guy anywhere in the city to watch him wander around, making random turns at every possible intersection. Bonus points if you let me drop like 500 little guys and they all do it.
note: built littleguys: drop up to 500 little guys anywhere in a real city and watch them wander the actual OSM street graph, random turn at every real intersection, dead ends just turn them around.
